peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (64.5): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 169 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 5 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jan 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 3.6 resales per 100 homes a year over 20 months (Feb 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 161 of 258 similar developments. First resale wave from Feb 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 3.8.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Mayflower MRT about 900 m, Bright Hill MRT about 1,040 m; closer than 65 of 462 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Ang Mo Kio Primary School about 1,300 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 220 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Jalan Leban Food Centre about 110 m; nearest park Central Catchment Nature Reserve about 60 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Teck Ghee MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,770 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Lentoria, 27 new sales, about 1,340 m; Lentor Mansion, 2 new sales, about 1,390 m; Lentor Gardens Residences, 299 new sales, about 1,500 m; Hillock Green, 15 new sales, about 1,610 m; Lentor Central Residences, 1 new sales, about 1,630 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 30 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 344 new sales and 198 resales (542 purchases); new sales were 63.5% of these purchases. Subsales (102) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Thomson Reserve development, about 1,670 m; Lentor Central GLS site (Mar 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,740 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 198 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 21 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 198 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 219 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.6%). Planning-area private resales +12.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
